alternate_basis_preparation.primary_test_requirements: Requires fresh native IK q/v, 91-component position/velocity gates, 101 anchor and 118 support knot checks, and global closed-arm rate comparison; static pointwise acceptance alone insufficient.

anchor_seeded_preparation.guess_policy: Independent C2 targets unchanged; six closed-arm coordinates interpolated only as native solver guesses, not prescribed targets

Historical 17 projected support poses are preserved for reference but are NOT gated support poses for this candidate.
